review:
A 6x5 swamp sequel with scatter wins: eight or more matching symbols anywhere pay and drop away. Each spin, a Fire Zone appears somewhere on the grid – 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 or full size – and special symbols landing inside it get extra power.

When the wins dry up, an Eater steps in to clear symbols, with a stronger version that does more. The Fire Zone gives every spin a different hot spot to watch. Extreme volatility, 30,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
